verdict.rationale: RudderStack is a SaaS customer-data platform with AI features (the Rudder AI Slack agent and an MCP server), so a policy or control preventing customer data from being used for model training is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no such opt-out or no-training commitment. PII blocking and masking, consent management, and storing data on your own infrastructure are adjacent privacy controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
